cases.expected: JsonSchema instance is returned; its schemaLocation equals "http://example.com/schema.json" and its schemaNode equals the supplied JsonNode
cases.description: Happy‑path test: all arguments are non‑null and well‑formed; verifies that getSchema forwards the arguments to newJsonSchema and the resulting JsonSchema reflects them.

cases.expected: JsonSchema instance is returned; its schemaLocation equals "http://example.com/schema.json" and its schemaNode equals the supplied JsonNode; a default SchemaValidatorsConfig is used internally
cases.description: Pass a null config to ensure the factory creates a default configuration rather than throwing an exception.

cases.expected: JsonSchema instance is returned; its schemaLocation equals "http://example.com/schema.json" and its schemaNode is null
cases.description: Pass a null JsonNode to verify that the method does not reject a missing schema document (some callers use a separate schema loader).
A null URI should cause an NPE because the method dereferences schemaUri.toString().

cases.expected: JsonSchema instance is returned; both jsonNode and config are null inside the created schema
cases.description: Both optional arguments are null – the method should still succeed, delegating to newJsonSchema.

cases.expected: JsonSchema instance is returned; its schemaLocation string includes the fragment "#fragment"
cases.description: URI contains a fragment; verify that the fragment is preserved in the SchemaLocation used by the created JsonSchema.

cases.expected: JsonSchema instance is returned; its schemaLocation string includes the query part "?version=1"
cases.description: URI contains a query string; ensure the full URI string is stored unchanged.

cases.expected: JsonSchema instance is returned; its internal validation context reflects the fail‑fast setting (e.g., first validation error aborts processing)
cases.description: Pass a custom SchemaValidatorsConfig with failFast enabled and verify that the resulting JsonSchema is created with that configuration.

cases.expected: JsonSchema instance is returned; its validation context has typeLoose set to true
cases.description: Configure the factory to allow loose type checking and ensure the flag propagates to the created JsonSchema.

cases.expected: JsonSchema instance is returned; its schemaLocation string equals "/relative/path/schema.json" and its schemaNode equals the supplied JsonNode
cases.description: Pass a relative URI (no scheme, host, or authority) to verify that the factory does not reject it and stores the exact string in the created SchemaLocation.

cases.expected: JsonSchema instance is returned; its schemaLocation string is empty ("") and its schemaNode equals the supplied JsonNode
cases.description: An empty URI string should be accepted; the resulting JsonSchema should carry an empty location without throwing an exception.

cases.expected: JsonSchema instance is returned; its schemaLocation string includes the encoded space "%20" exactly as supplied
cases.description: Ensures that URI encoding is preserved when the factory creates the SchemaLocation.

cases.expected: JsonSchema instance is returned; its schemaNode is a TextNode with value "just a string"
cases.description: The factory should accept any JsonNode, not only object nodes; verify that a primitive JSON value is stored unchanged.

cases.expected: JsonSchema instance is returned; its schemaNode is a NullNode (represents JSON literal null)
cases.description: Distinguish between a null reference (already covered) and a JsonNode that explicitly represents JSON null.

cases.expected: JsonSchema instance is returned; its internal ValidationContext reflects failFast, typeLoose and readOnly all set to true
cases.description: Pass a configuration object that enables several flags simultaneously and verify that all flags are propagated to the created JsonSchema.

group: URI with user info and port

cases.expected: JsonSchema instance is returned; its schemaLocation string equals "http://user:pass@example.com:8080/schema.json"
cases.description: Validate that authority components (user info, port) are retained unchanged in the SchemaLocation.

group: URI with fragment and query together

cases.expected: JsonSchema instance is returned; its schemaLocation string includes both the query "?ver=2" and the fragment "#section" exactly as supplied
cases.description: Ensures that when both a query string and a fragment are present, the full URI is preserved without loss or reordering.

cases.expected: IllegalArgumentException is thrown (thrown by SchemaLocation.of when the URI string contains characters that are not allowed in an IRI)
cases.description: Pass a URI that contains characters illegal for an IRI (e.g., a pipe '|'). The method should forward the string to SchemaLocation.of, which validates the IRI and throws IllegalArgumentException.

cases.expected: IllegalArgumentException is thrown (unsupported URI scheme for a JSON Schema location)
cases.description: Pass a URI with a scheme other than http, https, or file (e.g., ftp). SchemaLocation.of validates that the scheme is acceptable for schema locations and should reject unsupported schemes with IllegalArgumentException.
